operational_state: Hengyang becomes a methodical reduction/siege problem. Japanese 68th/116th-centered forces close local approaches, bring artillery/engineers forward and improve observation; no general city storm is authorized in this window.

node_transfer.airfield: JAPANESE_PHYSICAL_CONTROL; emergency fighter/recon use begins on a limited strip by 9-10 Jun, but medium/heavy-bomber-base credit remains denied
node_transfer.Chinese_rewire: IX War Area logistics/command and Fourteenth Air Force support remain distributed toward Leiyang/Lingling/Kweilin/Chenzhou; major stores continue moving south.
node_transfer.Japanese_rear: Changsha-Xiangtan network continues to mature under mixed Japanese/Nanjing security-administration, releasing additional Japanese line infantry from static duties only gradually.

decision_10Jun: CONTINUE_METHODICAL_REDUCTION; NO_BYPASS; NO_GUILIN_RELEASE. During the Marianas-focused window, surface China again only if Hengyang city/rail node changes hands, Japanese logistics crosses RED, or Fourteenth Air Force produces a major operational shock.
